pos.personaBrief: Wilson: 33% possession in the final, 'play and win with counters'; Mourinho: 'Let them have the ball but not create many chances', 16-24% at Camp Nou. Dominance is danger, not the ball.

pro.personaBrief: Inter released outlets early and long (Julio Cesar clearance to Milito, Il Post: launch it as far as possible); fast transitions with three-man front and few touches.

est.personaBrief: Compact disciplined lines, defined roles (Zanetti, Motta, Cambiasso responsible for zones), strikers with fixed duties; not relational combination play.

lar.personaBrief: No classic wingers: Eto'o and Pandev tucked in or sacrificed wide, Maicon provided width from full-back, Sneijder central; a central-heavy 4-2-3-1 / 4-3-1-2 with extra central players.

blo.personaBrief: Deep compact mid-low block, willingness to defend deep (Wilson), sacrificed width for compactness, let Barca and Bayern have the ball; high press only occasionally (Chelsea second leg).

mar.personaBrief: Mourinho says 'we didn't play man-to-man', everybody responsible for Messi's zone, and prefers zonal marking, with handovers; some close marking of Messi.

pla.personaBrief: 6x3x0 at Camp Nou, Eto'o as left-back, 4-5-1 reshaping, high press at Chelsea, provocation towards Van Gaal: plans tailored to each opponent.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic, result-first team, 'something extraordinary' means trophies; closed games out and rearguard action at Camp Nou.

sis.personaBrief: Eto'o a total team player, Sneijder dropped back to left midfield, Eto'o as left-back; everyone serves the plan, stars included.

jog.personaBrief: Disciplined, physical, experienced side with strong defensive midfielders and aerial strength; Sneijder as a technical trequartista who still worked back.

bas.personaBrief: Squad with average age in the thirties, veterans Zanetti, Samuel, Cordoba, Materazzi; buy-in of proven players (Lucio, Eto'o, Milito), no academy focus.

lid.personaBrief: Mourinho in charge with strong control (Julio Cesar shirt request, rules for all), yet strong us-against-the-world bond (Materazzi hug, celebrating with the dressing room).
